TEXT: And so, the days and months drifted by...
Since then, I behaved as the very model of a gallant otaku to gain favor from Saori's parents.
Before we knew it, they were saying things like, "His future's looking bright, this one's a keeper!"
And then today, despite Saori and I still being in high school, we were finally at our beautiful marriage ceremony.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: You're nervous, aren't you, Kyousuke-san?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Of course! It's a marriage after all, a marriage.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Oh no, it's not something to be worked up over.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: This is just for the sake of silencing my fussy parents. You could call it playing make-believe.
You're being pretty harsh to your parents, don't you think?!
"For the sake of my parents..."  Just where did the exemplary Saori go?!
Well, in her case, not holding anything back about her parents may be a good thing.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: It's a ceremony merely for appearances, because you haven't been entered into our family registry yet...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: So, don't tense your shoulders so much.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: *sigh*... You sure have it nice, you're not nervous at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: But... I am nervous...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: There's no way I wouldn't be...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I think I have experienced a few more things than most people.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: But wearing a wedding dress and being a bride... this is my first time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Saori...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Kyousuke-san, you just keep taking all my first times...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Don't say something so easily misunderstood.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: It was a compliment.①

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh, you...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: But, honestly speaking...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: This kind of pounding in my heart is a first in my life...
Saori looking embarrassed, fidgeted while looking downward.
When a man sees a girl behaving like this...
It makes him fall for her. Or... it makes him want to bully her...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Haha, I took yet another one of your first times, huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Eh...? A-Ah!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...You said to stop, yet here you are telling me the same thing.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: From now on, we have to be considerate of each other.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Don't worry.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I may not be reliable yet, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I will take responsibility and make you happy!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...Yes!
And so, Saori and I got married.
...What about the height difference?
...I'd be lying if I said I didn't care...
But, not enough to worry over it because...
My wife is the cutest in the whole world!
